items.claim: He possesses real power in his hands and a relaxed striking style.
items.quote: He's got real power in his hands. He has that relaxed striking style.

items.claim: His cardio is inconsistent and not great.
items.quote: What is also not great is his cardio. It's a bit inconsistent.

items.claim: He is coming off a second knockout loss in a row, this time to Brando Pericic.
items.quote: He is coming off that second knockout loss in a row, this time to Brando Pericic.

items.claim: He is a long, powerful fighter with solid takedown defense and can be gun-shy at times.
items.quote: He's taking on Kennedy Nzechukwu, a long, powerful guy with solid takedown defense. He can be gun-shy at times

items.claim: He is typically a pretty durable guy, but somewhat unreliable.
items.quote: He's typically a pretty durable guy, but he is somewhat unreliable.

items.claim: He moved up to heavyweight about 2 years ago and has looked good at this weight class.
items.quote: He moved up to heavyweight about 2 years ago, and while he hasn't completely reinvented his career, he has definitely looked good at this weight class.

items.claim: He has beautiful, long, rangy kicks when he wants to use them.
items.quote: He's got beautiful, long, rangy kicks when he wants to use them.
